scope: CPU source RGB audit of static high-track, non-clipped, low-gradient SfM observations. Brightness reference is per-track median across views; no correction applied. Specularity, correspondence uncertainty and vignette/scene correlations can remain.

half_track_exposure_crosscheck.scope: Fit one scalar linear exposure offset per view on even-ID source tracks, evaluate odd-ID tracks against per-track multi-view median. Diagnostic only; not independent photographic image validation.
